title: OdyTTY conformance result document
description: Public result contract for a pinned conformance run. The central design rule is that runner health and compatibility outcome are separate fields that are never collapsed: a run that failed to execute must never be readable as a compatibility pass, and a compatibility failure must never be readable as a broken runner.

schema_version.description: Version of this result contract. Incremented when a consumer would have to change to read the document.

generated_utc.description: Document creation time, UTC, seconds precision.

runner.description: Health of the harness itself. Says nothing about compatibility.

status.description: ok: the harness completed its work. error: the harness failed; no compatibility conclusion may be drawn. unsupported_platform: the harness cannot run here at all.

phase.description: Phase reached. On error, the phase that failed.

platform_class.description: Coarse platform label. Deliberately coarse: a precise host description is machine-identifying.

message.description: Sanitized explanation. Empty when status is ok.

upstream.description: Which suite was used, and what was actually proven about it.

verification.description: What was checked, as opposed to what was declared.

subject.description: The build under test. A result without an exact revision is not evidence.

revision.description: Exact commit SHA, or the literal string unknown. Never a branch name.

invocation.description: Argument vector as executed. Never a shell string: this harness never invokes a shell.

verified.description: False when the geometry was declared but could not be confirmed as applied. A false value must be accompanied by a limitation entry.

isolated_state.description: True when the run used a private configuration and state directory rather than the invoking user's.

cases.description: One entry per case considered. Cases that were not run appear with skip, ignore, or unsupported, never omitted: a silently absent case is indistinguishable from a case that was never written.

outcome.description: pass: observed correct. fail: observed incorrect. skip: not attempted this run. ignore: attempted, result deliberately not counted. unsupported: cannot apply here. There is no partial and no unknown; an unclear result is a fail or a skip with a reason.

reason.description: Required for every outcome other than pass. An unexplained skip is a hidden gap.

deviations.description: Documented, intentional differences from the reference behavior. Present and empty rather than absent when there are none, so an empty list is a statement rather than an omission.

totals.description: Counts per outcome. Must sum to the number of case entries; a total that disagrees with the case list is a corrupt document.

limitations.description: Everything that weakens this result. Required and may be empty only when nothing weakens it, which is rare enough to be worth justifying.
